video_title: Knicks Win the NBA Finals vs Wemby, Spurs???

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: New York Knicks face difficult matchup against Oklahoma City Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Oklahoma City is a bad matchup for them.
quotes.quote: They can beat San Antonio. I am not saying they will, they can. I do not think they can beat Oklahoma City. It is a matchup nightmare for them. It does well, they can negate Wemby a little bit because Jayson Tatum could snap a three right in your face, but they can put Cason Wallace on Cat and it is a problem. They have 100 guys that can guard any of those guys. I am not saying the Knicks are not going to show up, they are going to be fine. It is just Oklahoma City is a bad matchup for them.

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Scalabrine's confidence in the New York Knicks despite early struggles
quotes.excerpt: I would take the Knicks in five.
quotes.quote: When they were down 22, I was standing up with the remote about to go to bed. I said to myself, that did not look like the Knicks team. Everyone is saying, oh man, we blew Game 1. I would have got back on radio and said, I take the Knicks in five. To me, it did not look anywhere close. Even when they were down 22, I was saying, the Knicks are definitely going to be fine. I do not believe in the Cavs. I just do not. I do not believe that they have the it factor to win.

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland Cavaliers' analytical excuses for playoff series loss
quotes.excerpt: It is a wheel of excuses.
quotes.quote: Sometimes you cannot talk about your private conversations outside to the people that do not understand. That is one of those private conversations that you have in-house that you do not bring out and tell people. It happens every day and everybody has it in their own different way. It is a lapse in judgment to think you could say something like that. It does not help anybody and it is just like with the Cavs, it is like a wheel of excuses. They are still doing it now. Come on, we went to the Eastern Conference Finals, we were right there. No, you need to go get Giannis. You need to go do something different. We all know it, but they are coming up with reasons why they should not go do that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Scalabrine's preference for high-energy power forwards
quotes.excerpt: I was obviously super blessed to be around Kevin Garnett.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
text_blocks.text: I was obviously super blessed to be around Kevin Garnett. But name your favorite power forward to play with. Are they anything like Jared Allen or Evan Mobley?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: No, I have to say Allen Brand.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Scalabrine
text_blocks.text: He is a dog. Brand is a dog, you know? Like you need a dog. I like those guys. I am a big fan. Jared Allen is a cool dude, computers, taking apart, putting it back together. Evan Mobley is from USC. But I need like, I had Kenyon Martin, and then I had Kevin Garnett, and then I had Joe Kim Noah. That is how you win, right there.
